caveats: Google Maps rendered in a limited view in this browser session: ratings are Google's own, but review counts were generally not displayed. Counts quoted come from directory mirrors or the business's own markup where noted.
Google web search returned a CAPTCHA for this IP, so discovery relied on Google Maps, map listings and third-party directories rather than organic SERPs.
Phone-width checks were done at 390px with Chrome device emulation; screenshots were captured for Prestige, Evey's, Revive, Divine Bliss, Valora, MAANJ and Ocean Spring.
'Unclaimed' Google profiles are inferred from Maps showing 'Claim this business' or 'Add website'/'Add missing information' prompts rather than an explicit status label.
Scores are comparative within this batch of small North Brunswick service businesses, not absolute.
data_gaps: Google review counts unavailable for most businesses (Maps limited view); Prestige and 4 Ever counts taken from directory mirrors, MAANJ's from its own schema markup.
No review text was read for Lux Nails, Divine Bliss or Valora beyond star ratings, so operations signals for those are thin.
Evey's Beauty & Spa: whether the 'BOOK NOW' banner previously pointed to a scheduler that failed could not be determined.
Divine Bliss Studio: the provider behind Google's 'Book online' button could not be confirmed; the site itself embeds a LeadConnector calendar.
Valora Fitness: staff headcount, member numbers and whether the ID-verification step is mandatory for day passes are unknown.
MAANJ: no evidence found explaining why the Google profile is named 'Martial Arts Dojang' (possible DBA) - treated as a mismatch, not a conclusion.
No page needed a login, CAPTCHA or form submission; no forms were submitted anywhere.
